column3: Kirino Route · There's No Choice But To Use My Final Resort On My Little Sister
I'm begging you, please pursue "Rinko" together with me.
The nuance of your words has subtly changed.
...N-No, I just thought that you might not like how I said it the first time.
That's not the problem here! Don't you understand?
Tch... I can clearly see you're deliberately avoiding the issue.
However...
Now is not the time to be choosy with methods.
I know that Kirino is starting to give up on retrieving her memories.
And if she really were to do that, her memories would be gone for good. That's what I feel.
For that reason, I can't give up here.
W-What? You didn't care about me at all up till now, so why are you suddenly...?
Humph, it's really not for your sake.
Eh?
Don't misunderstand. It's not for my sake either. I'm simply keeping you company as your big brother till the end.
T-Then, why are you meddling like this for?
...For my little sister's sake.
...That's why, let's play "SisXSis". Kirino.
Do... Do whatever you want.
After a little while passed, Kirino simply said that and shut her mouth.
1: Unexpectedly, Rinko's lunch tasted better. 2: Of course, Miyabi's lunch tasted better.
This is the first choice in "SisXSis".
Incidentally, when I played this game with Kirino before, she vehemently refused to enter "Rinko's route" for some reason and chose Miyabi instead.
So, this time, I chose Rinko...
...Even so, Kirino hasn't said a word for a while now. What happened to her?
Hey...
Hm?
...Do you really want me to recover my memories that much?
Of course I do. If you stay like this, it'll be disheartening for Saori, Kuroneko and also Ayase.
Do you know how much trouble you caused because of your hobbies? To forget about that is too unfair, right?
...I understand.
Understand... what?
That you're working this hard for the sakes of myself, those otaku people, and also Ayase.
...What does she mean by that, in other words?
I know that you don't care about those memories. Right now, otaku interests are simply disgusting to you, right?
...S-So what?
Although it's too bad for Saori and Kuroneko, I feel that it can't be helped. However, I cannot accept that you treat us as strangers just because that.
Huh? Talking about 'treating you like a stranger' at this point... That sounds so pretentious.
Tch... This girl. She's obviously still unreasonably ridiculing me.
Shut up, I'm very hurt.
Listen well, regardless whether you've lost your memories, or whatever it is you've forgotten, that isn't the problem.
You... Do you know what you've just said? Don't you want to turn me back into an otaku?
I already said that's not it!!
Ah, sorry. My voice got a little loud there...
*sigh*, I also know I'm saying some really absurd things here.
However, I realized as I was shouting.
The real reason why I'm so desperate here...
Listen here, what's important is... that your hobby was the thing that made us start changing.
Because of your otaku interests, you were able to obtain Kuroneko and Saori as new friends.
Even Ayase, although you both got into a big quarrel over it at first, accepted the "otaku Kirino" in the end.
...So what are you trying to say? Why do you want to interfere?
...This brat, it looks like she won't get it if I don't say it clearly.
Because I've changed too.
Eh...
I made new friends thanks to learning about your hobby, and I also realized the things that I'm bad with.
And I feel that even my relationship with you improved a little.
All of us went through and overcame these changes as we spent time with you.
If you were to deny that, what are we supposed to do?
That's... That's just for the convenience of you guys.
Why do I have no choice but to turn back into an otaku, just so that I can accommodate you all?
There's no way I can accept something so unreasonable!
...Why are you so obsessed over this... even though you always ignored me?
What do my memories or whatever matter at this point?!
As if I would act so desperately for someone I didn't care about at all!
Ahh... Is she in her perverse confrontational mode again?
Geez, why does this thick-headed girl not get it?
Then, why am I trying to help you recover your memories to the point that I have to act so pitifully here?
How many times do you think I've been hit by you up till now since you lost your memories? I'll say it just in case, but I'm not that much of an M.
Shut up! You're just saying whatever you want! Without even knowing how I feel!
I'm also uneasy and anxious! I know that those otaku friends are seriously worried about me!
...I'll admit it. I'm impatient. Troubled. So uneasy that I'm on the verge of crying!
...K-Kirino?
But, I won't ask you for help. As if I would! I'm Kirino Kousaka! That's why...
I'll do what you want with my own strength! Just watch!
Kirino puffed her chest out, with no traces of doubt or weakness in her anymore.
She was exactly like the totally flawless little sister that I knew.
*sigh*... It can't be helped then.
This is also Kirino.
What I can do is... to simply watch over her.
Damn it! I'm only going to say it once...
Listen well! You're the most important person to me!
...Huh? Hold on, what are you saying?
How about it, laugh at me for being a perverted siscon! I'm hardcore siscon! No, I'm a die-hard siscon! Are you amazed?!
Uh... Ah? ...Eh?
Kirino... She's completely overwhelmed by my explosive frankness.
...However, why is her face slightly red?
I-I got it. It's fine if I just play, right?!  However, I don't know if my memories will return or not!
...Good grief. What happened during this year? Did you get along with the past me that much? That's impossible...
All right, it's time for the real match to begin!
You don't see me as a big brother, right? I don't care. I'm widely known as a failure of an older brother, after all.
Y-You turned serious suddenly.
Even so, I'm still your big brother! I can't help being worried like crazy about the little sister I hate so much!
L-Little sister, little sister, you keep saying that... Don't go acting like an big brother only at times like these!
Shut up! I'll keep saying it over and over!
I'm Kousaka Kirino's older brother! Your true big brother! Nothing more, nothing less! You have a problem with that?!
And being an older brother means that when I see my little sister troubled, I have to help her no matter what!
I-I'm not particularly troubled, though.
Don't try to hide it. I understand. I understand that you're forcing yourself right now.
W-Why, do you think that way...?
That's obvious. Because I'm your big brother.
Well then, we really got sidetracked just now. It's time to start the game already.
I face the game screen once again and smoothly start moving the mouse.
...I especially paid no mind to the gaze being burned into my back.
...My big brother can't be...
...can't be... this cool...
Sitting side by side in front of the computer like this reminds me of the day before Kirino went to study abroad.
Kirino is frowning somewhat, but well, this is all to recover her memories. I won't worry myself over it.
That's because, this really is the final resort.
This "SisXSis" is the last single thread of hope that connects me to Kirino's lost memories.
It seems the contents of the game have changed, the choices I selected when I played the game last time are highlighted in a different color.
I only completed the game once, so I didn't know this would happen.
In other words, these highlighted choices must be the route Kirino chose before.
In addition, based on the selected choices, it looks like they were from when she pursued "Rinko".
Which means, we could enter Rinko's route as long as we faithfully follow these. That's a little unbelievable.
How is it... Have you remembered anything?
As if it could be that easy. Just that... I feel that the "current me" would choose this.
...I see.
And then, as we continued playing the game, I finally started to understand why Kirino avoided "Rinko's route".
And, there's something I vaguely noticed when I last played "Miyabi's route", and confirmed as I now played "Rinko's route".
This little sister called "Rinko" is exactly the same as Kirino.
No, I'm not referring to her feelings inside. I'm referring to her attitude towards the hero.
Well, I can see why Kirino wants to avoid it. Since completing "Rinko's route" means Rinko and the hero fall in love with each other in the end.
Playing such a thing with my little sister next to me goes beyond awkward, it's dangerous!
Wait, isn't that the current situation?!
N-Not good... I'll keep playing the game with an empty state of mind from this point on.
...Honestly, the contents of the story is pretty common.
Suddenly cohabiting with his long lost younger sisters, the hero doesn't know how to treat "Rinko".
By developing a connection with his other little sister "Miyabi", the distance between the hero and "Rinko" gradually becomes closer.
The relationship between them becomes intimate, even eloping, but the hero falls unconscious right before that due to a critical condition.
On the other hand, "Rinko" gets brought back by their parents and sent aboard for studying.
To bid her elder brother farewell, she goes to the hospital alone, but...
W-What's this liquid streaming down my cheeks...
A-A-A-Am I crying? From playing a bishoujo game...?!
N-No, but... this can't be helped, right?
I looked back at the screen as the game enters its climax.
Because of a sudden traffic accident, "Rinko" has forgotten about the hero.
What's up with this, isn't this exactly the same as my current situation?
As she sees the hero struggling desperately for her sake, "Rinko" became frustrated over her lost memories.
Just like how I see myself as the hero, does Kirino also see herself as Rinko...?
...*sniff*.
...What's with this feeling... An unexplainable feeling welled up from the depths of my chest...
...Kirino... Could you pause for a moment?
I... really like the current you that's in front of me.
However, your lost memories are just as important... that's why I don't want to give up either of them!
So please... I beg you... please remember... your... our... precious... precious memories...
Damn! Why can't my tears stop flowing... I can't see Kirino's expression at this rate.
Thanks for restoring my sanity, dear sister.
Damn it, Kirino's right. Why am I calmly saying such embarrassing things?
Uh... S-Sorry... Looks like I lost my composure for a moment there...
Also... your shoulder has been touching me since earlier! You pervert! Siscon!!
...I'm sure you let out that clumsy confession just now because you were influenced by the game, but you don't understand Rinko-rin's story at all!
Listen well. Rinko-rin loved her elder brother since she was a child.
But due to an incident, her feelings towards her brother became complex, and before she knew it, she stopped noticing her own true feelings.
Although Rinko-rin lost her memories, upon seeing her devoted brother giving his all for her sake, her dormant feelings deep in her heart awakened.
Having lost her memories, but recalling her feelings, Rinko-rin mustered up her courage to confess to her elder brother. That line was...
...H-Hey! H-Hold on a minute!
W-What, I'm at one of the best parts!
No, I think I probably know that very line.
If I'm not mistaken, Saori had mentioned it before.
Shortly before Kirino lost her memories, she was quarreling with Kuroneko about a certain line by Rinko in "SisXSis".
That's... erm, it's that... that thing!
I-I can't remember it. How could I forget at a time like this?
Agh, why did you forget?!!! It's obviously "I've always, always loved you"! So you still haven't played it!
I-I'm sorry...
You're always like that! Even though I gave it to you as a present...
...Huh?
This girl, what did she just say?
K-Kirino... Why do you remember the signature phrase from Rinko's route...?!
Don't tell me... your memories came back?
W-wait. She's still only remembered that particular line by "Rinko". It might be a coicidence. Let's wait for her reaction.
Ah...Ah...Ah... I-I-I-I-I-I...
S-S-S-S-S-S-Shut up! Get out of here!
Guh!
T-That hurts... W-Why did you kick me just now?
Impossible, impossible, impossible, impossible...
E-Erm... Kirino? Are you all right?
S-So in the end, did your memories come back? Or did they not?
...Shut up. Stay quiet.
Uwoh! Her mood has suddenly taken a sharp turn for the worse?!
...Well, that's all.
W-Wait... Don't... Don't close the door!
Tch!
K-Kirino...?
...returned.
Eh?
My memories have returned! Got a problem with that?!
...Tch... She's using that abusive language of hers while wearing a sour look...
It's her same annoying face as always, but why does it look this cute now?!
That's great... That's great... Kirino...
S-Shut up! What's with you, saying gross things with a gross teary face?!
Gross, you say.... I-I can't help it, my tears won't stop.
Ah, you're really annoying. Wait here a moment.
Here, take this.
Umm... This is?
A-Anyway... Just leave me alone for the rest of the day.
And you better quickly complete all of "SisXSis", you idiot!!
This time, she closed the door for good.
I remained standing there, dumbfounded, while holding the laptop she gave me in one hand.
Pff... Hehe.
Hahaha... Well, in the end, it turned out like this.
That's right, it was "I've always, always loved you".
?! That's right! What, so you do get it!
Farewell... Big Brother, 【I've always, always loved you】.
Look! How was that, Rinko-rin's brave line?! It's so touching that it makes people cry... Actually, isn't it just godly?!
Why are you so elated about it...
No... Wait, isn't this...
In short, you're saying you can't accept bishoujo games psychologically and just can't stand playing a little sister moe game with your detestable elder
brother, right?
SisXSis. A crazy tale with a love triangle surrounding the hero and his two little sisters, cheeky but awkward Rinko, gentle and docile
Miyabi.
The hero acts cold to her like a stranger, becoming busy as he tries to help "Rinko" recover her lost memories, while being run down in both body and
mind.
She can't regain her memories. Her brother's getting more worn-out day by day as well. That made "Rinko" fall into self-hatred and close her
heart.
